intro: This errand delivers a canister of volatile NG-5 from the tinker Lomac Gearstrip to Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. Gaxim requires this unstable chemical to create a potent igniter for several wagons packed with dynamite. The resulting blast forms a critical distraction for Alliance operations in the disputed crags.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here you go, stranger. Take heed with it though... It's volatile stuff.
If you're really a friend of Gaxim's, then tell him I say hello. If you're not, then have fun blowin' yerself up.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your task has been done flawlessly, friend.
NG-5 is the unequivocal component in the recipe to ignite the wagons of dynamite.
What? Yes, dynamite... Wagons of it. It's the perfect distraction, I tell you... Just wait and see.
